value.answer: Depends if you mean soccer or NFL. Soccer: I'd go Messi. The 2026 coverage has pushed the debate further his way, with Argentina's Qatar title and a record 21 World Cup goals, though Ronaldo still has the Champions League scoring records. NFL: most people say Tom Brady, with seven rings and five Super Bowl MVPs, though Brady himself says Jerry Rice is still the GOAT. Which football did you mean?
